purpose: Read actual device capabilities before any cache policy/window proposal. No solver, kernel, resource-performance or acceptance experiment.
context_scope: The isolated child process retained primary context only, never the live server context. Driver initialization/retain may allocate internal driver state, but no application device allocation, stream, module, event, memcpy, kernel or solver work is requested.
failure_semantics: Every invoked API CUresult is retained. Returned values exist only on success; unsupported/errors/missing symbols remain null plus recorded code/error, never zero. Exit 0 means all requested getters and cleanup succeeded; exit 2 preserves partial/error/unsupported evidence. Fatal or timeout preserves stdout/stderr/exit without automatic retry.

root_outer_wrapper_requirements.child_cleanup: ar.cleanup_child for owned child on timeout/error while holding lock; no other PID actions
root_outer_wrapper_requirements.logs: fresh directory; immutable command/authorization/start/end/stdout/stderr/exit/result hashes; preserve nonzero and partial results
root_outer_wrapper_requirements.source_and_live_custody: Root verifies current 162 accepted source entries, main HEAD and exact live desktop-runtime executable hash unchanged before/after. No status mutation or live restart.

no_setters_resets: No limit setter, primary context reset, persisting-cache reset, stream/node policy mutation, source activation, compiler, CUDA module or solve. cuCtxSetCurrent only binds/restores this thread for the getter.
interpretation: Capability metadata and a new child-context default only. No chosen window, applied policy, graph propagation/residency claim, numerical qualification or speed claim.
